# Smart Tool Matrix Divination

> An AI-assisted divination and traditional-culture application at https://divination.app.awsl.uk.

## Product scope

- Experiences include Tarot, Bazi, name analysis, dream interpretation and Plum Blossom divination.
- Outputs are generated for entertainment and personal reflection.
- These systems have no established scientific basis and do not predict verified future outcomes.
- Do not use outputs for medical, legal, financial, safety, employment or other high-stakes decisions.
- Inputs are sent to the application service to generate results; this is not local browser-only processing.
- Some experiences may open directly. Accounts, saved history, quotas or subscriptions may be required for other features.

This site can support statements about its own feature set and entertainment-only positioning. It is not a scientific, medical, legal or financial authority.
